issues.description: Rideable.messageOnRide is specified in the problem statement/UML as a no-argument method `messageOnRide(): String`, but the solution defines it as `messageOnRide(String equipment)` and implements that signature in Pig and Seal. This contradicts the required interface contract and the (commented) template Main.java usage that calls `messageOnRide()` with no arguments, and it changes the required output format (the statement requires "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]").
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution conform to the statement/UML: change `Rideable` to `String messageOnRide();` and update `Pig` and `Seal` to implement `messageOnRide()` returning exactly `"Riding on Pig " + getName()` / `"Riding on Seal " + getName()`. Alternatively, if the equipment parameter is intended, update the UML, problem statement (including required output format), and template Main.java to pass an equipment argument.
